newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Globe Telecom to post net profit in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Globe Telecom to post net profit in 1998.

text.p: Cellular phone firm Globe Telecom GMCR Inc will continue to lose money this year but the company was sure to post profits in 1998, chairman Jaime Augusto Zobel de Ayala said on Monday.
"I think we will still be in a loss situation this year. But I do believe that next year, 1998, there's absolutely no reason why we shouldn't be in the black," Ayala told Reuters in an interview.
Globe has earlier forecast a net loss of 321.2 million pesos this year from a net loss of 750.9 million last year.
The company was hit by a large number of fraudulent calls made by organised groups using sophisticated cloning devices.
"We were hit quite significantly by fraud last year. However, I do believe that those problems are behind us," Ayala added.
